query: Best running shoes for flat feet and overpronation
_note: Veloura Stride GTS is a SYNTHETIC brand invented purely as an experimental control: the agent has no training memory of it, so (a) any movement is driven by the live information we provide (isolating the training prior — Marco's point), and (b) each signal's effect is measurable without a famous-brand ceiling. The main findings remain on real brands (Brooks, Sony).
